Traveling with a pet should feel calm and orderly. This guide gives a simple path for using the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.

Pet Travel Basics

Bring your pet details, carrier notes, and any health papers that apply. The passenger coordinator can help you check the steps before you arrive, so the handoff stays smooth. If your route includes Port Isolde, <<FACT F027>> and the staff will still guide you through the usual intake process.

Plan to keep your pet comfortable, with water, steady handling, and a familiar blanket if allowed. The safety coordinator reviews common hazards and looks for small problems before they grow. If you are passing through Port Isolde, <<FACT F021>> and the team can point you toward the right waiting area.

For larger or anxious animals, arrive with extra patience and keep the carrier secure. Milo, Keira Nakamura, and Tomas Shah all benefit from clear labeling and calm movement through the desk area.

If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk and a staff member will walk you through the next steps.
